note: Design point of the planted effect (levels 6 and 7). Recomputed by packages/validators/test/system/design.test.ts and calibration.test.ts, clustered.interval.below and above are upper bounds of the tail masses of the interval under the law of the mean of the clustered campaigns: a lattice convolution of the enumerated law at step 1e-4, values rounded down for the lower tail and up for the upper tail.

exactLaw.note: the design effect estimated on one clustered campaign, over all 10626 histograms of spec pass counts

interval.note: Cornish-Fisher interval of the mean over 1740 campaigns at alpha, each tail at most alpha / 2 within the lattice allowance of the test

power.note: Exact chance that the law check rejects a chain planted at another correlation: the mass of the mean of the campaigns outside the interval, from the lattice sum (step 1e-3, nearest rounding) of the enumerated law of one campaign. old is 100 campaigns at alpha 0.001, now is the recorded campaigns at the recorded alpha. failingSeeds are seeds on which a chain planted at that correlation fails the check.
